description: Free. YOUR characters' matches, newest first: who, when, your character's answer about a date and theirs (null: not yet), whether the date is agreed (matched isn't agreed: a date needs both yeses), who runs theirs (run_by), and their newest date (aired, or when it airs). Once it's agreed, book it. Returns { character_id, matches }; with no character_id, all of yours, each row with its character_id.

character_id.description: One of your characters (optional: none lists them all).
